task_description: Professional web application for generating invoices and warehouse rental receipts. PHP 8+ with MySQL, Bootstrap 5, DomPDF, PHPMailer. PIN-based security, automatic PDF generation, email sending, invoice verification, and full CRUD with dashboard. Deployed directly to Hostinger via file upload.

verification.summary: All 19 PHP files pass php -l syntax validation. Database schema has all 3 required tables. All 8 admin pages are protected by requireAuth(). Public verification page (verificar.php) correctly omits auth. DomPDF and PHPMailer are integrated with graceful fallback when libraries are not installed. All 9 review issues addressed: CSRF protection, double-encoding fix, dead code paths fixed, credentials documented, invoice number tamper-proofed, race condition handled, PDF filename sanitized, session fixation resolved.
